lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arranged in approximately five visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The first column contains four high-intensity circular blobs; the second column contains five. Centroids maintain a periodic horizontal and vertical spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect horizontal rows of circular blobs, forming a rigid grid-like structure of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance transition with a light upper margin and a shadowed lower margin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of high-luminance circular blobs on the lower anterior and medial portions of the first dorsal fin silhouette; the distal portion of the fin is out of the field of view.

other_distinctive_markers: Unique non-linear, maze-like luminance patterning forming a closed loop or 'target' shape located between the fourth and fifth vertical columns of spots on the mid-posterior flank.
